---
title: "Packages"
page-layout: full
---

```{r}
source("R/status.R")
library(reactable)

status <- read_status()
tab <- status_table(status)
pkgs <- status$packages
```

All `r nrow(tab)` packages, updated `r updated(status)`. Select a row to see
the package details, or search and filter using the boxes under each column
heading.

```{r}
# details shown when a row is expanded
package_details <- function(index) {
  pk <- pkgs[[index]]
  g <- pk$github
  cr <- pk$cran
  u <- pk$runiverse

  section <- function(heading, ...) {
    div(class = "col-md-6 col-lg-4 mb-3", h6(class = "text-uppercase text-body-secondary", heading), ...)
  }
  chips <- function(x) {
    if (!length(x)) return(span(class = "text-body-secondary", "None"))
    tagList(lapply(unlist(x), function(d) badge(d, "info")))
  }
  link <- function(href, text) if (!is.null(href)) tags$li(a(href = href, text))

  cran_text <- switch(cr$status,
    cran = paste0("Version ", cr$version, ", published ", cr$published,
                  if (!is.null(cr$deadline)) paste0(". Deadline: ", cr$deadline)),
    archived = cr$comment %||% "Archived",
    "Not on CRAN"
  )

  div(class = "container-fluid p-3",
    div(class = "row",
      section("About",
        p(pk$title %||% g$description %||% ""),
        if (!is.null(pk$maintainer)) p(class = "text-body-secondary", "Maintainer: ", pk$maintainer),
        if (!is.null(pk$notes)) p(pk$notes)
      ),
      section("Status",
        if (length(pk$issues)) {
          tags$ul(lapply(pk$issues, function(i) tags$li(i$text)))
        } else {
          p(class = "text-body-secondary", "No problems found")
        }
      ),
      section("CRAN",
        p(cran_text),
        if (!is.null(cr$first_release)) p(class = "text-body-secondary", "First released ", cr$first_release)
      ),
      section("Last commit",
        p(if (!is.null(g$last_commit)) paste0(substr(g$last_commit, 1, 10), " (", g$default_branch, ")") else "Unknown"),
        if (!is.null(g$last_commit_message)) p(class = "text-body-secondary", g$last_commit_message)
      ),
      section("Uses ICES packages", chips(pk$ices_dependencies)),
      section("Used by ICES packages", chips(pk$ices_reverse_dependencies)),
      section("Links",
        tags$ul(
          link(g$url, "GitHub repository"),
          link(cr$url, "CRAN page"),
          link(cr$checks$url, "CRAN check results"),
          link(u$url, "r-universe page"),
          link(u$build_url, "r-universe build log"),
          link(g$homepage, "Website")
        )
      )
    )
  )
}

reactable(
  tab[c("package", "health", "github_version", "cran_status", "cran_checks",
        "universe_checks", "open_issues", "open_prs", "last_commit")],
  details = package_details,
  onClick = "expand",
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  pagination = FALSE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  defaultSorted = "package",
  rowStyle = list(cursor = "pointer"),
  columns = list(
    package = colDef(name = "Package", minWidth = 260, cell = function(value, index) {
      div(div(class = "fw-semibold", value), div(class = "small text-body-secondary", tab$title[index]))
    }),
    health = colDef(name = "Status", minWidth = 140, cell = function(value) health_badge(value)),
    github_version = colDef(name = "GitHub", minWidth = 100),
    cran_status = colDef(name = "CRAN", minWidth = 110, cell = function(value, index) {
      cran_badge(value, tab$cran_version[index], tab$cran_url[index], pkgs[[index]]$cran$comment)
    }),
    cran_checks = colDef(name = "CRAN checks", minWidth = 110, cell = function(value, index) {
      check_badge(value, tab$cran_checks_url[index])
    }),
    universe_checks = colDef(name = "r-universe", minWidth = 110, cell = function(value, index) {
      universe_badge(tab$universe_build[index], value, tab$universe_url[index])
    }),
    open_issues = colDef(name = "Issues", minWidth = 70, align = "right", cell = function(value, index) {
      if (is.na(value) || value == 0) value else a(href = paste0(tab$github_url[index], "/issues"), value)
    }),
    open_prs = colDef(name = "PRs", minWidth = 60, align = "right", cell = function(value, index) {
      if (is.na(value) || value == 0) value else a(href = paste0(tab$github_url[index], "/pulls"), value)
    }),
    last_commit = colDef(name = "Last commit", minWidth = 110, format = colFormat(date = TRUE))
  ),
  theme = reactableTheme(
    backgroundColor = "transparent",
    color = "inherit",
    borderColor = "var(--bs-border-color)",
    highlightColor = "var(--bs-tertiary-bg)",
    inputStyle = list(backgroundColor = "var(--bs-body-bg)", color = "var(--bs-body-color)")
  )
)
```
